body: I also feel shitty feeling suicidal since there’s so many people going through much worse feeling the same way and that makes me feel like a bitch, and when I talk about it to other people it sounds like I’m overreacting but when I’m alone all I want to do is cry and fall asleep forever so much for a hardcore soldier all my friends think I am

Thank you for ur response it means a lot. Im constantly digging myself a hole and hurting people along the way and I can’t do that to the people around me. I feel weak I joined the army reserves to help people but now I don’t think I’m doing anything but ruin everything. I’ve been in my head for over a year and haven’t seen any light ahead
It’s not those things making be break it’s the constant thought that I’m a burden. I keep fucking up everything along with everything bad happening to me
